issues.description: PCRE2 performance issue is mentioned but lacks detail about why it's slow and when backtracking becomes problematic
issues.current_content:
Problem: PCRE2 regexes (`-P` flag) can be much slower than ripgrep's default regex engine.

Why it's slow: PCRE2 uses backtracking, which can have exponential time complexity on certain patterns and inputs.
issues.should_be: Should explain specific pathological patterns (nested quantifiers like (a+)+), provide concrete examples of when PCRE2 is worth using, and warn about exponential time complexity risks
